description: Save one verified final Explainer Studio what-if short as a completed job on the account. Pass the confirmed final video url, the What If style style_slug when one was used, the episode number when the turn makes several. This links the existing video without copying files, generating or charging tokens. Call it once per final video, after confirm_upload. Never pass local paths, job IDs, drafts or reference videos. On timeout repeat the same inputs; one video can register one result. Do not re-render or reupload to retry.

episode_index.description: Episode number when the turn makes several episodes.

studio_kind.description: Only for a Shorts Studio reel; omit for Explainer and What If videos. With a style_slug, the style's catalog format decides.

style_slug.description: style_slug of the What If style used; omit for the user's own reference or style.

url.description: Confirmed final video on the account; reuse on retries.

name: import_video
title: Import a video to post
